speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Meconium Aspiration Syndrome. The chest X-ray findings of fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance, combined with respiratory acidosis (low pH, elevated PaCO2) and hypoxia, are classic for airway obstruction and chemical pneumonitis caused by meconium aspiration. The requested test results for ABG and Chest_X-Ray have been reviewed, confirming this diagnosis; no further questions are needed.
